name: Manganic-Palimpsest
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond bioluminescent seas, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls solar potential controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
